On the right, the black man in the orange beanie (R1) stands in a defensive posture, shielding his face with his hands to block the incoming strike. The background features a gray concrete wall with a painted boxer graphic and a black punching bag on the left. The lighting is neutral and even, highlighting the focused training session and the physical interaction between the two athletes.
